welcomeBody:
## Start with a thought

This is your local knowledge space. Create documents, organize libraries, or import Markdown and Word files.

> Every idea worth keeping deserves a place of its own.

## Give knowledge room to grow

- Everything stays on this device
- Star important documents
- Export a full backup regularly

Write your first thought.
updateFailed: Update check or installation failed. Try again later.
saveFirst: Save failed. Edits are retained. Retry or export before closing.
liveHint: Edit formatted text directly · Type ## and a space for a heading · Ctrl+B bold · Ctrl+Z undo
sourceHint: Edit original Markdown · Ctrl+Z to undo
sourcePreserved: This document uses syntax not yet supported by live editing. Source mode preserves the original content.
linkHint: Set a link for the selected text. External links do not open automatically.
editorLimit: The document has reached its maximum length. This input was not saved.
historyHint: Up to 20 automatic checkpoints, one per minute, capped at 20 MB per note. Restoring preserves your current content. Permanently deleting a note also removes its history.
historyEmpty: No history yet. Editing and saving creates a checkpoint.
recentHint: Pick up where you left off
markdownFolderHint: Import Markdown and referenced local PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images from the selected folder. Missing images stop the import; files outside this folder are never read.
longDocumentSource: Long documents use source mode to reduce editing latency. All content is preserved when editing and exporting.
textEncoding: Unrecognized text encoding. Save as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM in your original editor, then retry.
relativeImageError: An image is missing, unsupported or outside the selected folder. Check Markdown image paths and import the folder again.
